title: Add accessible label and tooltip to the global navigation menu toggle
description:
Problem: a live browser audit on 2026-05-25 found the app bar drawer/menu icon button is visible on every primary route but has no accessible name and no tooltip/title. This makes the main navigation toggle ambiguous for screen-reader and pointer users.

Evidence: Playwright accessibility/DOM sweep of `/`, `/pages`, `/memories`, `/chat`, `/tasks`, `/proposals`, `/health`, `/tags`, `/maintenance`, `/admin`, `/about`, and `/profile` reported the top-left MudIconButton as unnamed on both desktop and mobile viewports.

Desired outcome: the global menu toggle exposes a stable accessible name and a short tooltip consistent with the rest of the app shell.

Scope:
- In scope: app shell menu toggle aria-label/title or MudTooltip, keyboard focus/name verification, and route-smoke coverage or an equivalent focused assertion.
- Out of scope: redesigning the nav drawer or route list.

Acceptance criteria:
- The global menu/drawer toggle has an accessible name such as `Toggle navigation`.
- Pointer users get a tooltip or equivalent title on hover/focus.
- The label is stable across the main app routes and both collapsed/open drawer states.

Validation:
- Run a browser accessibility snapshot on at least `/`, `/pages`, `/memories`, `/chat`, `/tasks`, and `/health` and confirm the app bar menu button is named.
- Run `npm run test:route-smoke` or the focused app-shell test after the change.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 2026-05-25 live browser audit: the app-shell menu MudIconButton was unnamed and had no tooltip on every primary route checked.
